name: telco-voice-central
description: Telco Voice Central conversational voice agent handling customer service, billing, tech support, sales, appointments, and account management.

variableDeclarations.name: clid
variableDeclarations.description: Caller ID 10-digit ANI phone number from telephony gateway

variableDeclarations.name: tfn
variableDeclarations.description: Toll-free number dialed by caller to drive brand routing

variableDeclarations.name: cirn
variableDeclarations.description: Customer Individual Reference Number, echoed last-4 only

variableDeclarations.name: billing_account
variableDeclarations.description: 10-digit Billing Account Number, echoed last-4 only

variableDeclarations.name: customer_type
variableDeclarations.description: Customer classification such as New or Existing

variableDeclarations.name: user_id
variableDeclarations.description: Internal CRM record identifier for customer account

variableDeclarations.name: business_flag
variableDeclarations.description: Indicator if caller account is a business account ('true' or 'false')

variableDeclarations.name: region
variableDeclarations.description: Geographic service region code such as Region-A, Region-B, or Region-C

variableDeclarations.name: auth_status
variableDeclarations.description: Authentication outcome status ('Pass' or 'Fail')

variableDeclarations.name: identification_status
variableDeclarations.description: Profile lookup identification outcome ('Pass' or 'Fail')

variableDeclarations.name: auth_attempts_remaining
variableDeclarations.description: Number of remaining authentication retry attempts

variableDeclarations.name: auth_method
variableDeclarations.description: Active verification modality ('otp' or 'pin')

variableDeclarations.name: route
variableDeclarations.description: Target specialist module name

variableDeclarations.name: lob
variableDeclarations.description: Line of business ('mobility', 'internet', 'tv', 'homephone', 'smarthome')

variableDeclarations.name: tv_sub_type
variableDeclarations.description: TV service delivery type ('streaming', 'satellite', 'streaming_only')

variableDeclarations.name: language
variableDeclarations.description: Locked caller language code ('primary' or 'secondary')

variableDeclarations.name: utterance
variableDeclarations.description: Most recent caller intent transcript used for routing and topic switching

variableDeclarations.name: dtmf_digits
variableDeclarations.description: Normalized DTMF keypad digits captured during current turn

variableDeclarations.name: local_noinput_counter
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive silent turns on current module

variableDeclarations.name: no_match_confirmation_count
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive disambiguation retry count

variableDeclarations.name: global_err_count
variableDeclarations.description: Cumulative cross-module validation error count

variableDeclarations.name: misc_counter
variableDeclarations.description: General purpose flow counter for iterative steps

variableDeclarations.name: mock_mode
variableDeclarations.description: Flag enabling hermetic mock execution for tests ('True' or 'False')

variableDeclarations.name: last_pmt_amt
variableDeclarations.description: Last recorded billing payment amount

variableDeclarations.name: amount
variableDeclarations.description: Transaction, refund, or installment amount under discussion

variableDeclarations.name: ban_type
variableDeclarations.description: Billing account tier ('ConsumerPostpaid', 'Prepaid', 'SMB')

variableDeclarations.name: is_prepaid
variableDeclarations.description: Indicates if customer subscription is prepaid ('true' or 'false')

variableDeclarations.name: loyalty_limit
variableDeclarations.description: Maximum dollar limit for automated dispute credit approval

variableDeclarations.name: dispute_charge_id
variableDeclarations.description: Identifier of the specific line item under billing dispute

variableDeclarations.name: ticket_id
variableDeclarations.description: Support or dispute case tracking identifier

variableDeclarations.name: ticket_state
variableDeclarations.description: Current status of support ticket ('open', 'in-progress', 'closed')

variableDeclarations.name: vr_task_count
variableDeclarations.description: Iteration step counter for virtual repair diagnostics

variableDeclarations.name: item_list
variableDeclarations.description: Serial numbers or hardware codes for provisioned customer equipment

variableDeclarations.name: intent_type
variableDeclarations.description: Sub-classification of customer intent or technical issue

variableDeclarations.name: api_resp
variableDeclarations.description: Diagnostic payload of most recent external service response

variableDeclarations.name: selected_plan_id
variableDeclarations.description: Catalog plan SKU selected by customer during sales flow

variableDeclarations.name: order_id
variableDeclarations.description: Hardware or plan order tracking reference number

variableDeclarations.name: delivery_eta
variableDeclarations.description: Estimated delivery date window for shipped hardware

variableDeclarations.name: appt_id
variableDeclarations.description: Unique field technician appointment identifier

variableDeclarations.name: selected_slot
variableDeclarations.description: Customer selected appointment time slot

variableDeclarations.name: technician_status
variableDeclarations.description: Field technician dispatch status ('scheduled', 'en-route', 'completed')

variableDeclarations.name: sms_type
variableDeclarations.description: Transactional SMS template type ('Public' or 'Private')

variableDeclarations.name: sms_content
variableDeclarations.description: Outbound SMS message text body

variableDeclarations.name: sms_destination
variableDeclarations.description: Target mobile number for outbound SMS delivery

variableDeclarations.name: day_val
variableDeclarations.description: Transient temporary variable for parsed day value

variableDeclarations.name: date_val
variableDeclarations.description: Transient temporary variable for parsed date value

variableDeclarations.name: month_val
variableDeclarations.description: Transient temporary variable for parsed month value

variableDeclarations.name: end_time
variableDeclarations.description: Transient temporary variable for appointment window end time

variableDeclarations.name: flag_val
variableDeclarations.description: Transient scratchpad flag for multi-turn step completion

variableDeclarations.name: active_advisory
variableDeclarations.description: Active regional service alert advisory text

variableDeclarations.name: handover_id
variableDeclarations.description: Identifier for telephony ACD live agent escalation transfer

variableDeclarations.name: queue
variableDeclarations.description: Target telephony queue name for escalation transfer

variableDeclarations.name: session_id
variableDeclarations.description: Unique virtual repair or diagnostic session identifier

variableDeclarations.name: first_diagnostic_question
variableDeclarations.description: Initial diagnostic prompt from virtual repair system

variableDeclarations.name: new_slot
variableDeclarations.description: Selected reschedule timeslot string for field service

variableDeclarations.name: reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason code for escalation, dispute, or suspension action

variableDeclarations.name: notes
variableDeclarations.description: Detailed agent notes attached to dispute or support ticket

variableDeclarations.name: zip
variableDeclarations.description: Customer service address zip code for technician availability

variableDeclarations.name: service_type
variableDeclarations.description: Requested service or installation type for technician dispatch

variableDeclarations.name: charge_id
variableDeclarations.description: Line item charge identifier evaluated for billing credit or dispute

variableDeclarations.name: days
variableDeclarations.description: Turnaround window in business days for billing adjustments and refunds
